previous.review_surface: Original returned pixels actually inspected through white and black alpha composites; raw file retained unchanged.
previous.observation: Actually viewed raw, white/black, original source, initial three-view design and previousv02. Correct far anatomical-LEFT occlusion remains and directional shading improved. But the same visible coil geometry is now almost entirely mint, losing the broad ash-gray hair surfaces that should match bob; this is a pigment-layout error, not natural view occlusion. Agree with Sol actual round45 preliminary: keep current far-side contour/root hiding/body and restore broad uniform ash-gray hair base with narrower uniform mint structural bands. Hidden beads are acceptable; do not expose them or flip the root again. Needs one coherent whole redraw and fresh review, not promotion because flatness alone passed.
